tasks.query: A screening test has sensitivity 0.94 and false-positive rate 0.099. The prevalence of the condition is 0.048. Given a positive result, what is the probability that the person has the condition? Round to six decimals.

Among 168 students, 104 take art, 80 take biology and 91 take chemistry; 45 take both art and biology, 70 take art and chemistry, 38 take biology and chemistry, and 35 take all three. How many students take none of these subjects?
